title: call
description:
Client -> robot. Two-way audio control. Intercepted by the bridge like `video`; the motion daemon never sees it.

Capability-gated: advertise "call" in ack.capabilities. Robot-side mute state comes back on daemon_status.robot_local_mic_muted, not here -- robots boot muted and are unmuted by a person at the robot, so a client cannot unmute them remotely.

A frame may carry `state`, `mic_muted`, or both: joining with an explicit initial mute is one frame, and a later mute toggle is a frame with `mic_muted` alone.

mic_muted.description: Operator mic muted. A local track toggle; never a renegotiation.

clip.description: This join exists only to play a one-shot audio clip, not to open a conversation. Implies a muted mic and an immediate leave when the clip ends.

robot_mic_muted.description: Reserved: operator mutes the ROBOT's mic. Implemented by the L2 bridge. Distinct from `mic_muted`, which is the operator's own mic. The robot's resulting state is reported back on daemon_status.robot_local_mic_muted.
